pitch:
An Instagram reel and LinkedIn video from May11Leven Labs, a design and technology studio. Brand identity from $800.
The video: 6 seconds, looping, giant black type on off-white. One word turns like a rolling drum: Sell, Book, Reply, Get paid, Grow. Under it, fixed: "while you sleep."
Caption (thought-leadership style, short lines):
"Most businesses close at 6pm. Their customers don't.
They look you up at 11pm. They message at midnight. They compare you with someone else before breakfast.
By the time you open, the decision is often made.
Your website, your replies and your brand are working the night shift whether you planned it or not. The question is whether they're any good at it.
That's the work we do: brand identity, websites, apps and WhatsApp assistants built for the hours you're not there.
Comment 11 and we'll look at what your business does after 6pm, free."
Ask: comment 11 for a free look at what your business does after closing time.
